text:
Evan: Orbit QBR scheduled Fri 10am PT. We need a bite-sized slide set: health one-liner, onboarding runway, renewal signal, single exec ask. Pls drop final bullets here by Wed EOD.

Marta: I'll own health. Plan: p95 latency trend, demo pass-rate, and 30d active seats. Will call out the two error spikes from last week.

Sophie: I'll handle onboarding + blockers. Current cohort = 6 accounts: 4 green, 1 blocked on SSO cert, 1 blocked on schema mapping. SE assigned. ETA cert = 3 business days; schema = 8 business days.

Alex: Renewal flag: one enterprise account moved to AMBER after a failed exec demo. I'll post a single-sentence blurb we can use.

Nikhil: For the exec ask I propose: "Approve 5-week canary Dedicated pool for top accounts + up to 30 SE hours to remove demo blockers." I'll draft expected outcomes and a compact cost delta.

Evan: Alex, paste the short risk line (one sentence + mitigation). Keep it exec-friendly.

Alex: "Renewal risk: AMBER  one enterprise account experienced demo failures during an exec POC; mitigation: propose 5-week canary Dedicated pool and prioritized SE triage"

Marta: I'll include a small table: p95 before/after pilot and estimated cost per 1k tokens. Want me to highlight routes?

Sophie: Yes highlight data.connect and embeddings.index. Embeddings uptake lags on accounts with connector errors.

Nikhil: Also include a fallback line if pilot is not approved: routing to lower-latency region + demo-run checklist + temporary retries. Keep it one row.

Evan: Logistics: deck link -> https://drive.redwood/Orbit-QBR-Pulse (add slides by Thu 9am PT). Dry run Thu 2pm PT. notifier-bot will push invites.

notifier-bot: Created event: Orbit QBR dry run  Thu 14:00 PT. Invitees: Evan, Marta, Sophie, Alex, Nikhil.

Marta: Adding one-liner customer quote for health slide: "Model quality solid; demo reliability inconsistent when large datasets attach" (anonymized).

Sophie: I added the onboarding timeline and owner matrix to Drive and tagged SE and Security for the SSO cert.

Alex: Uploaded incident notes and ticket #4521 summary. Included repro steps and suggested hotfix.

Nikhil: Drafted exec ask slide with a tight ROI line: expected incremental renewal probability * ARR vs pilot cost. Keeping conservative numbers.

Evan: Two small asks: (1) keep slide text to max 2 bullets; (2) put mitigation next to each risk line.

Marta: Charts uploaded. Calling out routes text.generate and embeddings.search.

Sophie: Confirmed ETAs and owners in Drive.

Alex: Confirmed risk blurb in the doc.

Nikhil: If pilot approved, ops will need a config window for canary routing  I'll coordinate with eng.

Evan: Recap: slides in Drive by Thu 9am PT; dry run Thu 2pm PT; final deck to exec Fri 8am PT. Thanks team  ping if stuck. :thumbsup:
